tasks.short: Search reference materials to answer patrons' questions

steps.what: Clarify the patron's reference question and capture search constraints
Search reference materials and assemble supported candidate answers

loop.purpose: Find relevant passages and draft a sourced answer
loop.input: Reference brief and retrieved source passages
loop.output: Candidate answer with passage citations and explicit gaps
loop.check: Librarian opens cited passages and checks that they answer the actual question without overstating abstracts
loop.stop: One retrieval refinement; missing or conflicting support returns to manual research
loop.why_not_simpler: Keyword search finds records but does not compare their meaning against a natural-language question

steps.what: Verify the answer against sources and explain findings to the patron

tasks.design: Test the research assistant already available in {OTHER}, the library discovery system. Restrict drafting to retrievable passages, retain source checks and let the librarian explain uncertainty and finish unanswered searches.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching across sources and comparing relevance takes repeated reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked research assistants can draft answers from retrieved abstracts.
tasks.still_hard: Abstract coverage can be incomplete and a valid citation may not support the claim.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian clarifies the real need and judges source fitness.

ambition.what: Offer an assisted first reference consultation to staff unfamiliar with specialist collections

tasks.altitude: Less first-pass search time; the librarian retains response responsibility.

evidence.claim: Primo Research Assistant answers from the top five abstracts with source links.
The proposed labour reduction is an unmeasured task scenario, not a product result.

assumptions: Boundary includes question clarification, search and librarian response; source creation and patron time are excluded.

Librarian captures subject, intended use, language, date range and access limits in s1's15 hours. Existing cataloguers and publishers produce source records in unchanged work. Missing metadata triggers manual search; the loop uses source text rather than invented structured facts.
Test native discovery features before custom retrieval. Existing search runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Do verified answers cover the patron's actual need with less total search and review time?

already_counted.description: Source relevance and final response verification

incremental.description: Review failed retrievals and maintain source access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R67, gross33 minus5 upkeep net28. Low assumes only13 hours search reduction due to weak abstract coverage; clarification and response remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise library operations, budgeting, planning and personnel

steps.what: Gather operating totals and prepare library budget and planning tables
Set priorities, supervise daily operations and make personnel decisions

tasks.design: Use native reporting in {OTHER}, the library management system, and approved {ERP} exports for repeatable planning tables. Keep priority setting, hiring, training, scheduling judgement and performance conversations with the librarian.
tasks.previous_blocker: Operating and finance records may require repeated table assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured reports and protected spreadsheet imports can reuse existing records.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing access, service priorities and individual staff needs.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian handles tradeoffs and fair personnel decisions.
tasks.altitude: Less table assembly; supervisory authority is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Configured operational reporting may reduce table assembly; personnel and planning decisions remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is librarian supervision including existing planning preparation, excluding payroll processing and separately owned transaction entry.

Finance staff produce approved account, period and amount records; library transaction processes produce item, date and circulation event records. These unchanged upstream captures are not new free labour. Librarian reconciles periods and missing fields within s1's10 remaining hours; missing exports use manual tables.
Test native reports before custom dashboards; no staff scoring or automated hiring is proposed.
research_questions: Can existing reports reduce table preparation without increasing reconciliation work?

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and period definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gives10 gross minus3 upkeep net7. Low assumes only3 hours assembly removed;80 hours of supervision and personnel work stay intact.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and teach information literacy and technology classes

steps.what: Plan information literacy classes and prepare examples and exercises

loop.purpose: Adapt existing teaching examples to stated learning goals
loop.input: Librarian-selected goals, verified examples and existing lesson structure
loop.check: Librarian checks factual accuracy, source validity, accessibility and whether each exercise teaches the intended skill
loop.stop: One revision then manual planning if unsuitable
loop.why_not_simpler: Adapting explanations to learner needs requires reading meaning; fixed templates alone do not do that

steps.what: Teach classes and guide learners through information and technology exercises
Assess understanding and identify changes for the next class

tasks.design: Reuse existing lesson structures in {DOCS} before adding a bounded draft assistant for exercises. The librarian selects goals, verifies the complete class plan and keeps all teaching and assessment time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rewriting examples for different audiences takes preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded text assistant can propose exercise wording from selected material.
tasks.still_hard: Novice misconceptions and accessibility needs emerge during teaching.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian adapts explanations in response to learners.
tasks.altitude: Less drafting; teaching responsibility and class contact remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Align exercises with observable learning goals

evidence.claim: Drafting exercises from approved material is plausible model capability; no library teaching time result is supplied.

assumptions: Boundary includes class preparation, delivery and assessment, excluding creation of external source materials.

Librarian selects goals, audience level, source examples and accessibility requirements within s1's15 remaining hours, including full draft checks. Missing or unsuitable sources mean manual preparation.
Test reusable native document templates first. Drafting never substitutes for learner contact.
unknowns: Preparation share and reusable lesson coverage
research_questions: Does assisted drafting reduce preparation after accessibility and factual checks?

already_counted.description: Goal selection and complete exercise review

incremental.description: Maintain lesson prompts and remove outdated examples

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90,10 gross minus3 upkeep gives7 net. Low assumes only3 hours drafting saved;65 teaching and10 assessment hours remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Code, classify and catalog library materials

steps.what: Inspect library materials and capture their identifying information
Find a matching catalogue record and copy reusable bibliographic fields
Classify subject matter and complete the catalogue description

loop.purpose: Suggest subject headings and missing descriptive fields
loop.input: Inspected item information, bibliographic draft and approved vocabulary
loop.output: Proposed description and subject headings with supporting item passages
loop.check: Librarian checks that headings describe the actual subject and edition, not just valid vocabulary codes; checks each proposed field against the item
loop.stop: One correction attempt; uncertain classifications are catalogued manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Vocabulary validation is deterministic but choosing a subject requires semantic interpretation

steps.what: Verify the complete record and save the accepted classification and catalogue entry

tasks.design: Test native copy cataloguing in {OTHER}, the library management system, before adding metadata or subject suggestions. Validate vocabulary codes automatically, then let the librarian check meaning, edition identity and the full record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: New items require repeated description and subject assignment even when reusable records exist.
tasks.enabler_now: Catalogue assistants draft metadata and subject suggestion tools can propose headings.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous subjects, uncommon editions and weak source metadata.
tasks.human_edge: The librarian judges how a material should be discovered by its audience.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass description; classification authority remains with the librarian.

reach.learn: Edition matching and controlled subject vocabularies

evidence.claim: Alma AI Metadata Assistant drafts catalogue records from title, author or title-page images for cataloguer acceptance or correction.
Annif provides subject suggestions and was tested with the Dutch Brinkman thesaurus.
The proposed savings are an unmeasured scenario including semantic review.

assumptions: Boundary runs from inspecting one acquired material to saving its record; acquisition and supplier catalogue creation are excluded.

Librarian produces title, author, edition, identifier when present, medium and content notes during s1's20 hours. Shared-catalogue producers supply existing records through unchanged cataloguing work. Missing identifiers or uncertain matches use manual description; no free structured subject input is assumed.
Native copy cataloguing comes first. Model suggestions cannot save records or merge editions autonomously.
research_questions: Do draft suggestions reduce total cataloguing time after edition and subject checks?

already_counted.description: Match checks, semantic classification review and final record check

incremental.description: Maintain vocabulary mappings and examine recurring metadata errors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R67.5 gives32.5 gross minus5 upkeep net27.5. Low assumes only12 hours first-pass description reduction because many editions require manual work; inspection and final save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: More time for reference judgement and teaching, with less initial search and catalogue drafting.
reach: Support library technicians with source and edition checks
Work with instructional coordinators on information-literacy exercises
role.ambitious_version: A librarian who broadens access to reliable information while retaining responsibility for reference quality and collection description.
